name: El Niño / La Niña
summary: Super El Niño: ONI +2.5°C for Aug–Oct
state: NOAA's Oceanic Niño Index for August–October was +2.46°C, far above the +1.5°C threshold for a strong event (NOAA CPC). Strong El Niños usually peak in northern winter; reports on 4 Nov describe drought hitting crops and cattle in southern Africa and South-east Asia (Malay Mail).
for_you: El Niño shifts rainfall worldwide: drought risk rises in southern Africa, South-east Asia and Australia, and food prices can follow. Follow your national weather service's seasonal outlooks.

sources.title: Malay Mail — El Nino wreaks havoc across continents as food prices loom

why: ENSO reshapes global weather for a year at a time — droughts, floods, hurricanes and crop yields.
drivers: Pacific trade winds and ocean heat content.
